known.title: Gate: live starter tests in the full suite

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - the scheduled full-suite run on main.
Removing FORGE_STARTER_LIVE makes existing live starter checks skip or omit their runtime assertions; for example, tests/test_defaults_history.py:18-19 now skips its real API test. Removing Node 24 and Corepack setup also removes prerequisites checked by tests/test_starter_tree.py:163-168. The separate starter-smoke workflow has no scheduled trigger, so it does not replace this nightly coverage. The full-suite status can consequently turn green without exercising these contracts. Preserve the live-test setting and prerequisites in the generated nightly workflow.
findings.title: Gate: live starter tests in the full suite

stop.reason: The owner moved the nightly live starter tests to their own fix: run them in the starter workflow on a schedule, so the full run stays under its limit
